scope: Inventory-authored changes to this module's 03_design_spec.md, delivered in commits 1e9f8159 and 31324ff1 as part of inventory-purchase-provider/1.1

§2.6 items 7 and 9, §3.5 confirm step 3, §8.8: reversal rows are no longer INSERTed or PK-reserved before the Inventory call; ownerProof comes from the original GR/Details locked at step 6; real Inventory IDs come back first; sourceLineId and originalSourceLineId are both the original GR Detail ID, with the fixed per-reversal event_id distinguishing successive partial reversals

§4.13: inventory_movements.reversal_of_movement_id keeps its unique constraint; purchase partial reversal uses the append-only inventory_purchase_reversal_links table (migration 0101, Inventory-owned) with a locked SUM check, superseding the former 'remove the unique constraint' requirement

§2.4 and §8.7: the inline Inventory command example and its caller-supplied authorization.purpose / requiredCallerPermission object are removed; the ABI is inventory-purchase-provider/1.1 §2-3, with a server-issued opaque context, per-line locked commitment, and findOperationsBySource semantics where NOT_FOUND proves nothing and COMPLETED requires full membership verification
§8.9: reversal reconciliation is per-event on (GOODS_RECEIPT_REVERSAL, original GR ID, reversal event_id, original GR Detail ID) rather than on new Reversal Detail PKs
No purchasing schema change and no purchasing migration follow from this approval

pending_decisions.question: Who is the accountable Purchasing & Receiving module owner for design, risk and business-acceptance decisions?

requirement.md 18.3 listed OPEN-001 through OPEN-005 as unconfirmed while design_spec.md 0.2 had already closed them with concrete business rules. Adopt the design resolutions as the approved business baseline, or keep them open pending per-item approval?
design_spec.md targets MySQL 5.7 while CI runs mysql:8.0 and the Inventory module baseline is MySQL 8.0. Which is the compatibility baseline for Purchasing & Receiving?
Should the aligned requirement, design and plan be recorded as DRAFT pending a later human review, or approved in this run as a planning baseline?

docs/supplier_management/00_module_manifest.json pins the deleted docs/purchasing_receiving_management/design_spec.md (sha256 b09f5726...) as a consumed contract source. Should this run repoint it to 03_design_spec.md (sha256 a29fb66d...), or does it belong to the Supplier module owner?
OPEN-006: which open POs are migrated, on what cutover date, with what legacy previously-received quantities, and who owns the Inventory Opening reconciliation and Go-Live sign-off?

TASK-006 and TASK-007 implement the Inventory purchase-receipt batch and partial-reversal contracts under server/src/modules/inventory/**, which is in neither allowed_write_paths nor approval_required_paths for this module. Should Purchasing implement them in the Inventory module under an agreed contract, or should the Inventory module owner deliver them as a provider task?

The consumed contract inventory-purchase-receipt-batch-and-partial-reversal pins docs/inventory_management/03_design_spec.md, but that document does not specify postPurchaseReceiptBatchInTransaction or reversePurchaseReceiptBatchInTransaction at all - it specifies only a single-detail RECEIVING contract. Should the pin point at a provider document that actually specifies the two contracts once Inventory writes one (issue #267), or should Purchasing's own design remain the only source?
